text:
Swiss watch exports rose 9.1% in October to CHF 2.46 billion. Fifth month of growth in a row.

Steel did most of the work (+11.2%), with gold-steel up 28.3%. Precious metal watches were flat (+0.4%). January to October, exports were close to CHF 22 billion, up 3.4% on last year.

By market, the US jumped 60.8%, but the FH says that is a favourable base effect linked to US tariffs. China fell 12.1%.

The FH's own caution: higher gold prices, a strong Swiss franc and US tariffs all weigh on margins. These are export figures, not shop sales. November's data comes out on 17 December.

Source: Federation of the Swiss Watch Industry (FH), October 2026 export statistics, published 19 November 2026.
